chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Part of muru'ah is managing wealth properly."

key_terms.اسْتِصْلَاحُ: putting something in order, improving, and managing properly
key_terms.الْمُرُوءَةِ: honor, dignity, and noble human conduct
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How does Islam view proper management of wealth as part of good character?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that proper care and sound management of one's wealth are part of noble character and dignity. It presents financial responsibility as an ethical virtue within the Prophetic tradition.
